segments.sn42.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
segments.sn42.8:1.2: Atha kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi nigaṇṭhasāvako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho asibandhakaputtaṃ gāmaṇiṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn42.8:1.3: “kathaṃ nu kho, gāmaṇi, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetī”ti?
segments.sn42.8:1.4: “Evaṃ kho, bhante, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.sn42.8:1.5: ‘yo koci pāṇaṃ atipāteti, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci adinnaṃ ādiyati, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci kāmesu micchā carati, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci musā bhaṇati sabbo, so āpāyiko nerayiko.
segments.sn42.8:1.6: Yaṃbahulaṃ yaṃbahulaṃ viharati, tena tena nīyatī’ti.
segments.sn42.8:1.7: Evaṃ kho, bhante, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetī”ti.
segments.sn42.8:1.8: “‘Yaṃbahulaṃ yaṃbahulañca, gāmaṇi, viharati, tena tena nīyati’, evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati, yathā nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa vacanaṃ”.
segments.sn42.8:2.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, yo so puriso pāṇātipātī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya, katamo bahutaro samayo, yaṃ vā so pāṇamatipāteti, yaṃ vā so pāṇaṃ nātipātetī”ti?
segments.sn42.8:2.3: “Yo so, bhante, puriso pāṇātipātī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya, appataro so samayo yaṃ so pāṇamatipāteti, atha kho sveva bahutaro samayo yaṃ so pāṇaṃ nātipātetī”ti.
segments.sn42.8:2.4: “‘Yaṃbahulaṃ yaṃbahulañca, gāmaṇi, viharati tena tena nīyatī’ti, evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati, yathā nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa vacanaṃ”.

segments.sn42.8:6.1: “Idha, gāmaṇi, ekacco satthā evaṃvādī hoti evaṃdiṭṭhi [evaṃdiṭṭhī (ka.)]–
segments.sn42.8:6.2: ‘yo koci pāṇamatipāteti, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci adinnaṃ ādiyati, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci kāmesu micchā carati, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci musā bhaṇati, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko’ti.
segments.sn42.8:6.3: Tasmiṃ kho pana, gāmaṇi, satthari sāvako abhippasanno hoti.
segments.sn42.8:6.5: ‘mayhaṃ kho satthā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi – yo koci pāṇamatipāteti, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayikoti.
segments.sn42.8:6.7: Atthi kho pana mayā pāṇo atipātito, ahampamhi āpāyiko nerayikoti diṭṭhiṃ paṭilabhati.
segments.sn42.8:6.8: Taṃ, gāmaṇi, vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.sn42.8:6.9: Mayhaṃ kho satthā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi – yo koci adinnaṃ ādiyati, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayikoti.
segments.sn42.8:6.11: Atthi kho pana mayā adinnaṃ ādinnaṃ ahampamhi āpāyiko nerayikoti diṭṭhiṃ paṭilabhati.
segments.sn42.8:6.12: Taṃ, gāmaṇi, vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.sn42.8:6.13: Mayhaṃ kho satthā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi – yo koci kāmesu micchā carati, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko’ti.
segments.sn42.8:6.15: Atthi kho pana mayā kāmesu micchā ciṇṇaṃ.
segments.sn42.8:6.17: Taṃ, gāmaṇi, vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.sn42.8:6.18: Mayhaṃ kho satthā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi – yo koci musā bhaṇati, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayikoti.
segments.sn42.8:6.20: Atthi kho pana mayā musā bhaṇitaṃ.
segments.sn42.8:6.22: Taṃ, gāmaṇi, vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.sn42.8:7.1: “Idha pana, gāmaṇi, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
segments.sn42.8:7.2: So anekapariyāyena pāṇātipātaṃ garahati vigarahati,‘pāṇātipātā viramathā’ti cāha.
segments.sn42.8:7.6: Tasmiṃ kho pana, gāmaṇi, satthari sāvako abhippasanno hoti.
segments.sn42.8:7.8: ‘bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena pāṇātipātaṃ garahati vigarahati, pāṇātipātā viramathāti cāha.
segments.sn42.8:7.9: Atthi kho pana mayā pāṇo atipātito yāvatako vā tāvatako vā.
segments.sn42.8:7.10: Yo kho pana mayā pāṇo atipātito yāvatako vā tāvatako vā, taṃ na suṭṭhu, taṃ na sādhu.
segments.sn42.8:7.11: Ahañceva [ahañce (?)] kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ.
segments.sn42.8:7.12: Na metaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ [pāpakammaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)] akataṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.sn42.8:7.13: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya tañceva pāṇātipātaṃ pajahati.
segments.sn42.8:8.1: “‘Bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena adinnādānaṃ garahati vigarahati, adinnādānā viramathāti cāha.
segments.sn42.8:8.2: Atthi kho pana mayā adinnaṃ ādinnaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā.
segments.sn42.8:8.3: Yaṃ kho pana mayā adinnaṃ ādinnaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā taṃ na suṭṭhu, taṃ na sādhu.
segments.sn42.8:8.4: Ahañceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ, na metaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ akataṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.sn42.8:8.5: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya tañceva adinnādānaṃ pajahati.
segments.sn42.8:9.1: “‘Bhagavā kho pana anekapariyāyena kāmesumicchācāraṃ garahati vigarahati, kāmesumicchācārā viramathāti cāha.
segments.sn42.8:9.2: Atthi kho pana mayā kāmesu micchā ciṇṇaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā.
segments.sn42.8:9.3: Yaṃ kho pana mayā kāmesu micchā ciṇṇaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā taṃ na suṭṭhu, taṃ na sādhu.
segments.sn42.8:9.4: Ahañceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ, na metaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ akataṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.sn42.8:9.5: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya tañceva kāmesumicchācāraṃ pajahati, āyatiñca kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti.
segments.sn42.8:10.1: “‘Bhagavā kho pana anekapariyāyena musāvādaṃ garahati vigarahati, musāvādā viramathāti cāha.
segments.sn42.8:10.2: Atthi kho pana mayā musā bhaṇitaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā.
segments.sn42.8:10.3: Yaṃ kho pana mayā musā bhaṇitaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā taṃ na suṭṭhu, taṃ na sādhu. Ahañceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ, na metaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ akataṃ bhavissatī’ti.
segments.sn42.8:10.4: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya tañceva musāvādaṃ pajahati, āyatiñca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti.
segments.sn42.8:10.5: Evametassa pāpassa kammassa pahānaṃ hoti. Evametassa pāpassa kammassa samatikkamo hoti.
segments.sn42.8:11.5: Pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti.
segments.sn42.8:11.6: Pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti.
segments.sn42.8:12.1: “Sa kho so, gāmaṇi, ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatabyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
segments.sn42.8:12.2: Seyyathāpi, gāmaṇi, balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasireneva catuddisā viññāpeyya;
segments.sn42.8:12.3: evameva kho, gāmaṇi, evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā evaṃ bahulīkatāya yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ, na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati.
segments.sn42.8:13.1: “Sa kho so, gāmaṇi, ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatabyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato karuṇāsahagatena cetasā … pe … muditāsahagatena cetasā … pe ….
segments.sn42.8:13.3: Upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
segments.sn42.8:13.4: Seyyathāpi, gāmaṇi, balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasireneva catuddisā viññāpeyya;
segments.sn42.8:13.5: evameva kho, gāmaṇi, evaṃ bhāvitāya upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā evaṃ bahulīkatāya yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatī”ti.
segments.sn42.8:14.1: Evaṃ vutte, asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.8:14.2: “abhikkantaṃ, bhante, abhikkantaṃ, bhante … pe … upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Aṭṭhame yaṃbahulaṃ yaṃbahulanti iminā nigaṇṭho attanāva attano vādaṃ bhindati.
Tasmā bhagavā evaṃ sante na koci āpāyikotiādimāha.
Purimāni pana cattāri padāni diṭṭhiyā paccayā honti.
Tasmā tesupi ādīnavaṃ dassento idha, gāmaṇi, ekacco satthā evaṃvādī hotītiādimāha.
Tattha ahampamhīti ahampi amhi.
Mettāsahagatenātiādīsu yaṃ vattabbaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ saddhiṃ bhāvanānayena visuddhimagge vuttameva.
Seyyathāpi, gāmaṇi, balavā saṅkhadhamotiādi pana idha apubbaṃ.
Tattha balavāti balasampanno.
Saṅkhadhamoti saṅkhadhamako.
Appakasirenāti akicchena adukkhena.
Dubbalo hi saṅkhadhamo saṅkhaṃ dhamantopi na sakkoti catasso disā sarena viññāpetuṃ, nāssa saṅkhasaddo sabbato pharati, balavato pana vipphāriko hoti, tasmā “balavā”ti āha.
Mettāya cetovimuttiyāti ettha “mettā”ti vutte upacāropi appanāpi vaṭṭati,“cetovimuttī”ti vutte pana appanāva vaṭṭati.
Yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammanti pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ nāma kāmāvacaraṃ vuccati, appamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ nāma rūpāvacaraṃ.
Tañhi pamāṇaṃ atikkamitvā odhisakaanodhisakadisāpharaṇavasena vaḍḍhetvā katattā appamāṇakatanti vuccati.
Na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatīti taṃ kāmāvacarakammaṃ tasmiṃ rūpārūpāvacarakamme na ohīyati na tiṭṭhati.
Kiṃ vuttaṃ hoti?
Taṃ kāmāvacarakammaṃ tassa rūpārūpāvacarakammassa antarā laggituṃ vā ṭhātuṃ vā rūpārūpāvacarakammaṃ pharitvā pariyādiyitvā attano okāsaṃ gahetvā patiṭṭhātuṃ vā na sakkoti.
Atha kho rūpārūpāvacarakammameva kāmāvacaraṃ mahogho viya parittaṃ udakaṃ pharitvā pariyādiyitvā attano okāsaṃ katvā tiṭṭhati, tassa vipākaṃ paṭibāhitvā sayameva brahmasahabyataṃ upanetīti.
Iti idaṃ suttaṃ ādimhi kilesavasena vuṭṭhāya avasāne brahmavihāravasena gahitattā yathānusandhināva gataṃ.

lines: “Yo koci puriso pāṇātipātī musāvādī, sabbo so āpāyiko”ti vatvā puna “yaṃbahulaṃ yaṃbahulaṃ karoti, tena duggatiṃ gacchatī”ti vadanto attanāva attano vādaṃ bhindati.
Evaṃ santeti yadi bahuso katena pāpakammena āpāyiko,“yo koci pāṇamatipātetī”tiādivacanaṃ micchāti.
Cattāri padānīti “yo koci pāṇamatipātetī”tiādinā nayena vuttā cattāro atthakoṭṭhāsā.
Diṭṭhiyā paccayā honti “atthi kho pana mayā”tiādinā ayoniso ummujjantassa.
Balasampannoti samattho.
Saṅkhadhamakoti saṅkhassa dhamanakicce cheko.
Adukkhenāti sukhena.
Upacāropi appanāpi vaṭṭati ubhinnaṃ sāmaññavacanabhāvato.
Appamāṇakatabhāvo labbhateva.
Tathā hi taṃ kilesānaṃ vikkhambhanasamatthatāya dīghasantānatāya vipulaphalatāya ca “mahaggatan”ti vuccati.
